title: 4i eSports
description: 4i eSports is a high-stakes Hardcore Minecraft server (1.21.1) featuring permadeath, competitive world borders, and native Bedrock/Java cross-play support. Join a community where every life counts and survival is the ultimate goal.
body:
Modrinth ke description ke liye ye ek professional aur engaging draft hai. Isme aapki Hardcore settings aur 4i Esports ki branding dono cover ho jayengi.

Aap ise copy karke Modrinth ke description box mein paste kar sakte hain:

🏆 Welcome to 4i Esports Hardcore
Welcome to the ultimate survival challenge. 4i Esports is a high-stakes, competitive Hardcore Minecraft server designed for players who want to test their skills in a world where every decision matters. One mistake, and you are out!

💀 Server Mechanics
Permadeath: If you die, you are automatically banned from the server. There are no second chances.

Version: Running on the latest Minecraft 1.21.1.

Anti-Cheat: Advanced Anti-Xray and Movement checks (GrimAC) to ensure a fair competitive environment.

World Border: A limited Overworld and Nether border to encourage player interaction and resource competition.

🎮 Features
Cross-Play Support: Play seamlessly from Java Edition or Bedrock Edition (Mobile/Console).

Optimized Performance: Powered by high-end hardware and Velocity Proxy for a lag-free experience.

Custom Projects: Check out our server-wide builds, including the massive ancient Indian architecture-inspired Colosseum!

Cracked Friendly: Secured with high-level login protection for all players.

🔗 Join Us Today
Ready to take the risk?

Server IP: play.4iesports.com

Port: 19132

Discord: [Join our community to stay updated on unban events and server seasons!](https://discord.gg/4C5ucrHwYt)
